title: Juniper and the Oath
author: Rosalind Brightwater
blurb: Jude Villalobos, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
